preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 1000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == 2*n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**6 for x in a) for a, n in zip(arrays, ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array a contains exactly 2n positive integers, each between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The total sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.expression: all((line.startswith('YES') or line.startswith('NO')) for line in stdout_lines if line.strip())
postconditions.description: The output consists of lines where each test case starts with either YES or NO.

postconditions.expression: all((not (line.startswith('YES') and len(lines[i+1:]) < 1) and not (line.startswith('NO') and len(lines[i+1:]) > 0 and lines[i+1].strip() and not lines[i+1].strip().isdigit())) for i, line in enumerate(stdout_lines) if line.strip())
postconditions.description: If YES is printed, the next line contains an integer x, followed by n lines each containing two integers. If NO is printed, no further lines follow for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(check_valid_sequence(a, x, ops) for a, x, ops in zip(arrays, initial_xs, operation_pairs))
postconditions.description: For every test case where YES is output, the sequence of operations is valid: starting with x, each step removes two elements summing to the current x, and x is updated to the maximum of the removed pair, until all elements are removed.

postconditions.expression: all(not check_valid_sequence(a, None, []) for a in arrays if not is_possible(a))
postconditions.description: For every test case where NO is output, no valid sequence of operations exists that removes all elements.
